chars.WIFE: a Moroccan woman of 33 with long wavy dark-brown hair loose, wearing a fitted emerald-green satin kaftan with gold trim, gold hoop earrings
chars.NEIGHBOUR: a handsome young Moroccan man of 27 with a neat short beard and styled black hair, wearing a tight white polo shirt and beige chinos, silver watch
chars.HUSBAND: a Moroccan man of 38 with short black hair, slight stubble and a thick moustache, wearing a dark navy button-up shirt with sleeves rolled and grey trousers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from across a crowded Moroccan living room party (salon with banquettes, colourful cushions, tea trays), as if from where the husband stands: WIFE rushes and throws her arms around NEIGHBOUR in a big joyful hug, her face beaming with happiness, NEIGHBOUR smiling surprised. Head-to-waist framing of the two, faces clearly visible, centred. Soft evening lamp light. 2D cartoon illustration, flat colours, clean lines.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND standing in a doorway of a festive Moroccan salon holding a small glass of mint tea frozen mid-air, eyebrows raised, jaw tight, staring off to the side in shocked disbelief. Head-to-waist, face visible, centred. Blurred guests behind. 2D cartoon illustration, flat colours, clean lines.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Wide view of a Moroccan family party in a salon: WIFE in the centre laughing loudly while serving pastries to a group of chatting female guests in colourful djellabas; in the background at the edge of the hallway HUSBAND quietly slips away toward a bedroom door, glancing back over his shoulder. 2D cartoon illustration, flat colours, clean lines.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Inside a Moroccan bedroom, door slightly open with party light behind: HUSBAND bending over the bed and carefully picking up a closed silver laptop with both hands, looking toward the door nervously, sneaky expression. Face visible, centred. 2D cartoon illustration, flat colours, clean lines.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND sitting on the edge of the bed holding the closed laptop on his knees, sweating, drops of sweat on his forehead, staring into space, thinking intensely, worried face. Bedroom with Moroccan patterned blanket. Face visible, centred. 2D cartoon illustration, flat colours, clean lines.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night in a Moroccan bedroom, dim blue light: WIFE asleep in bed in the background, HUSBAND sitting in the foreground secretly scrolling her smartphone, screen glow on his face, disappointed shrug because he finds nothing. Face visible, centred. 2D cartoon illustration, flat colours, clean lines.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Daytime Moroccan living room: HUSBAND sitting on a banquette with an open laptop, WIFE leaning over his shoulder from behind with arms crossed and a suspicious raised eyebrow, watching what he is doing; HUSBAND smiling awkwardly. Both faces visible, centred. 2D cartoon illustration, flat colours, clean lines.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND alone in the bedroom, sitting on the floor against the bed, opening the laptop lid, the screen light glowing on his determined, nervous face, the bedroom door half open behind him with party lights and a silhouette of guests far away. Face visible, centred. 2D cartoon illustration, flat colours, clean lines.
